decoder_cell_fields.recovered_scalars: Claimed original x scalars; audit all, crosscheck consistency with word and scalar fields
decoder_cell_fields.scalar: Claimed original x when non-null; audit independently even if statuses disagree
decoder_cell_fields.trace_id: Joins closed trace independently; cell model/method variants are dependent views
decoder_cell_fields.words[].candidate_scalar: x: integer candidate in original [x]G=Q equation
decoder_cell_fields.words[].candidate_scalar_prime: k: integer candidate in transformed [k](aG)=bQ equation
decoder_cell_fields.words[].public_checks: Ignore both booleans completely as evidence
decoder_cell_fields.words[].status: RECOVERED marks an explicitly claimed solution, including claimed zero if present; status is only scope selection, never proof

enumeration_rule: Every complete parseable cell; include every word with RECOVERED and every non-null claimed scalar/recovered_scalars value, including inconsistent duplicate field claims. Do not treat non-RECOVERED candidate_scalar words alone as claimed solutions. Preserve and flag disagreement/unknown schema as undefined rather than silently exclude.

provenance.role: Strict finite unique-key UTF8 JSON, LF-complete JSONL; flags insufficient.
Coordinator read return-schema only; reviewer gets this schema declaration, never implementation.

semantic_freeze: Reviewer writes its interpretation and independently derives normalization from [k](aG)=bQ before evaluating candidate equations. Never select an interpretation because it happens to equate. If schema remains ambiguous, report INCONCLUSIVE and exact ambiguous rows.

trace_fields.base_multiplier: a: coefficient of original public base G in transformed base aG
trace_fields.target_multiplier: b: coefficient of original public target Q in transformed target bQ
